title: Google endpoint management (Cloud Identity Devices API, read-only scope through domain-wide delegation)
readScopes: OAuth scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-identity.devices.readonly, added to the google_workspace service account's domain-wide delegation, acting as GOOGLE_ADMIN_EMAIL. It reads GET https://cloudidentity.googleapis.com/v1/devices (devices.list, view USER_ASSIGNED_DEVICES). Google documents that a service account cannot call the Devices API directly; domain-wide delegation is required.

checks.title: Each device reports its storage as encrypted
checks.scope: Every listed device, one result per device, from encryptionState: ENCRYPTED passes, NOT_ENCRYPTED fails, UNSUPPORTED_BY_DEVICE and unspecified are skipped.

checks.title: The operating system's built-in firewall is on
checks.scope: Every device that reports through Endpoint Verification, from additionalSignals.is_os_native_firewall_enabled; other devices are skipped.

checks.title: Each device runs an OS at or above the given minimum version
checks.scope: Every listed device, from osVersion against --google-endpoints-min-os for its deviceType (mac_os, windows, linux, chrome_os, android, ios); without that option the check is skipped once.

checks.title: Each device has synced with Google within the last 14 days
checks.scope: Every listed device, from lastSyncTime; the window is --google-endpoints-sync-days.

checks.title: No device is reported compromised
checks.scope: Every listed device, from compromisedState: UNCOMPROMISED passes, COMPROMISED fails, unspecified is skipped.
